providers.name: Claude Code (Claude Pro/Max)
providers.statusReason: Anthropic does not permit third-party apps to route requests through Pro/Max credentials on behalf of users; unclear whether driving the user's own unmodified claude binary is allowed. Human decision needed before P2 sub-step 5.
providers.limits: Subscription usage limits of the user's Claude plan. The free claude.ai plan does not include Claude Code.
steps: Sign in with your Claude Pro or Max account in Claude Code
Test with claude -p, all tools off
providers.privacyNote: Resume text is sent to Anthropic under your Claude plan's consumer terms.

providers.name: Google Gemini API
providers.regionReason: Gemini API terms: only Paid Services may be used when making API clients available to users in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK.
providers.limits: Per-project limits shown in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/rate-limit); requests per day reset at midnight Pacific. No numbers published in the docs.
steps: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with a Google account
providers.privacyNote: On the free tier Google uses your prompts and responses (your resume and job posts) to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them.

providers.name: Groq
providers.limits: Free plan, no card needed (a card is asked only to upgrade). Limits per model are shown in the Groq console; checked 2026-11-11.
steps: Open the Groq console and sign in
providers.privacyNote: Groq does not train on your inputs and keeps no inference data by default (abuse logs up to 30 days).

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.statusReason: No permanent free tier: $5 trial credits that expire after 30 days and need a payment method. API training terms are in PDFs not yet verified.
providers.limits: Trial: 5 RPM, 30K uncached TPM, 1M tokens per day; context 64-65K.
steps: Sign up at Cerebras Cloud and add a payment method
providers.privacyNote: Cerebras says it does not retain inference inputs and outputs.

providers.logoSource: https://openrouter.ai/brand (glyph, ink and cloud variants; rule: don't stretch, recolor or remix; checked 2026-11-11)
providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.modelsNote: Three curated picks (D6). Free ':free' models are refused for resume content. Every request sends provider {data_collection: deny, zdr: true, require_parameters: true}. Prices are read live (OpenRouterCatalog).
providers.picksNote: Pick ids written 2026-11-11 from the Claude 5 family naming; the live models endpoint returned a stripped list that day, so ids are unconfirmed. All stay qualified=false until offerlane-modelcheck passes live.

picks.use: Sonnet-class tailoring and parsing, Haiku-class scoring.
picks.privacy: Sent only to providers that keep nothing (zero data retention) and don't collect data.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.statusReason: Checked 2026-11-11: API now needs pay-as-you-go plus credit (no free tier found). Commercial terms 4.2 say no training unless opted in, but retention period is not published and 2.2(i) needs written approval to grant third parties access. Reachable through OpenRouter meanwhile.

steps: Sign in to the Mistral console
providers.privacyNote: Training use of free-mode API data is not confirmed.

providers.statusReason: GitHub Models was fully retired on 2026-07-30.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.limits: 10,000 Neurons/day free, reset 00:00 UTC; text generation 300 requests/min. Some models need the paid plan.
steps: Sign in to the Cloudflare dashboard
Create an API token with Workers AI access
Paste the Account ID and token here
providers.privacyNote: Cloudflare does not train on your content and does not keep inputs or outputs for standard requests.

providers.privacyNote: Data use depends on the underlying provider; not confirmed.

providers.name: Ollama (on this Mac)

steps: Download a model sized for this Mac
